narrative.northStar: The Bloomberg of Biopharma Catalyst Arbitrage
narrative.overview: biOF is an institutional-grade financial intelligence interface designed for biopharmaceutical equity analysts, healthcare hedge funds, and quantitative risk managers. In biopharma trading, capital allocation is governed by binary regulatory milestones rather than quarterly accounting cycles.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Latency Information Architecture with instant multi-variable sorting and filtering
Deterministic Regulatory Semantics with strict color-status correspondence
Dual-Stack Typography pairing Chivo UI sans with JetBrains Mono tabular numeric alignment

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Emerald and Crimson are strictly reserved for financial safety/gain and regulatory risk/loss respectively. They must never be applied for aesthetic decoration.

rules.name: The Zero-Costume Depth Rule
rules.body: Never use hard cartoonish block shadows. All depth must come from surface tonal steps and subtle glow boundaries.

dos: Do align all numbers, dates, timestamps, and ticker codes in monospace font (JetBrains Mono).
Do preserve 1px precision structural borders between all data columns and panel modules.
Do maintain high visual contrast ratios against dark backgrounds for rapid triage.
donts: Don't use generic consumer pastel gradients, decorative illustration cartoons, or playful rounded pills.
Don't apply colored border-left strips wider than 1px.
Don't use green or red for non-financial or non-regulatory statuses.
